settings.name: USE_CROWDSEC
settings.description: **Enable CrowdSec:** Set to `yes` to enable the CrowdSec bouncer.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_API
settings.description: **CrowdSec API URL:** The address of the CrowdSec Local API service. Leave empty to disable decision lookups.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_API_KEY
settings.description: **CrowdSec API Key:** The API key for authenticating with the CrowdSec API, obtained using `cscli bouncers add`.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_MODE
settings.description: **Operation Mode:** Either `live` (query API for each request) or `stream` (periodically cache all decisions).

settings.name: CROWDSEC_ENABLE_INTERNAL
settings.description: **Internal Traffic:** Set to `yes` to check internal traffic against CrowdSec decisions.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Request Timeout:** Timeout in milliseconds for HTTP requests to the CrowdSec Local API in live mode. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is milliseconds.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_EXCLUDE_LOCATION
settings.description: **Excluded Locations:** Comma-separated list of locations (URIs) to exclude from CrowdSec checks.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_CACHE_EXPIRATION
settings.description: **Cache Expiration:** The cache expiration time in seconds for IP decisions in live mode. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_UPDATE_FREQUENCY
settings.description: **Update Frequency:** How often (in seconds) to pull new/expired decisions from the CrowdSec API in stream mode. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_BAN_REFRESH
settings.description: **Ban Refresh:** Turn CrowdSec blocks into short BunkerWeb bans that are renewed while the CrowdSec decision lasts. The value is the longest a ban lasts before CrowdSec is asked again. `0` disables it. A service with a `CROWDSEC_EXCLUDE_LOCATION` never gets CrowdSec bans. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_APPSEC_URL
settings.description: **AppSec URL:** The URL of the CrowdSec Application Security Component. Leave empty to disable AppSec.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_APPSEC_FAILURE_ACTION
settings.description: **Failure Action:** Action to take when AppSec returns an error. Can be `passthrough` or `deny`.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_APPSEC_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Connect Timeout:** The timeout in milliseconds for connecting to the AppSec Component. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is milliseconds.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_APPSEC_SEND_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Send Timeout:** The timeout in milliseconds for sending data to the AppSec Component. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is milliseconds.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_APPSEC_PROCESS_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Process Timeout:** The timeout in milliseconds for processing the request in the AppSec Component. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is milliseconds.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_ALWAYS_SEND_TO_APPSEC
settings.description: **Always Send:** Set to `yes` to always send requests to AppSec, even if there's an IP-level decision.

settings.name: CROWDSEC_APPSEC_SSL_VERIFY
settings.description: **SSL Verify:** Set to `yes` to verify the AppSec Component's SSL certificate.
